_about: Lexicon expansion with FastText (notebook 04). 'candidates' = every word proposed by the embedding neighbours of the seed terms (score = mean cosine similarity x log(1+number of seeds that proposed it)). 'accepted' = words kept after manual review. Rejected words were mostly spelling look-alikes without the same meaning (e.g. 'trash' near 'crash', 'flow' near 'slow') or generic words ('check', 'view', 'show'). Some accepted words were not proposed directly but are the phrase the proposed word belongs to (e.g. 'master' -> 'master card').
